name: cloud-quran-api
_comment_migrate_remote: ASK FIRST. `wrangler d1 migrations apply cloud-quran --remote` writes to the LIVE database. The remote database exists (created 2026-08-24, region EEUR) with migrations 0000-0002 applied, so this is not a no-op. It also spends the account-wide write budget — which BILLS rather than errors: this comment said the opposite until story 5-5, on a free-tier premise that stopped being true around 2026-07. Deliberately not a script: it should be typed on purpose, not tab-completed.
_comment_deploy: `deploy` is `wrangler deploy --env production`, explicitly. There is deliberately NO `deploy:dev`: the top-level wrangler.toml block is marked ENVIRONMENT=development (which ENABLES the dev token issuer) and shares the real production database_id, so publishing it anywhere would put a dev-marked worker on live data. Local development is `wrangler dev`, which deploys nothing.
